name: Humanities
description: Breadth of worldly, non-magical learning: history, politics, manners.

name: History
description: Knowledge of the past — dynasties, wars, and the old magical orders.

name: Modern Politics
description: Grasp of present-day powers, factions, and law.

name: Etiquette
description: Poise and correct conduct in polite and courtly company.

name: Shaping
description: Practical command of raw magic — bending mana into a working effect.

name: Shaping Speed
description: How quickly you can raise and release a shaped effect.

name: Shaping Precision
description: How finely and accurately you can control a shaped effect.

name: Mana Awareness
description: Sensitivity to the flow of mana in the world around you.

name: Self Mana Awareness
description: Sensitivity to your own reserves, flow, and strain.

name: Magical Theory
description: Formal, book-learned understanding of how magic works.

name: Perception
description: How much you notice — physical detail, and subtle change.

name: Insight
description: Reading people and situations beneath the surface.
